wollastonite_structure_retrieval_subtask.name: CaSiO3 Structure Retrieval for Surface Area
wollastonite_structure_retrieval_subtask.description: Retrieve structure of wollastonite CaSiO3 and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

wollastonite_potential_file_subtask_sa.name: CaSiO3 Potential File for Surface Energy
wollastonite_potential_file_subtask_sa.description: Procure an appropriate ReaxFF potential file for CaSiO3 for MD simulations. Return the absolute path of the potential file.

wollastonite_bulk_energy_minimisation_su.name: CaSiO3 bulk minimisation for Surface Energy
wollastonite_bulk_energy_minimisation_su.description: Given paths to LAMMPs-compatible wollastonite CaSiO3 structure file and a ReaxFF potential file appropriate for MD simulations, perform structure relaxation of CaSiO3 based on given simulation parameters. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in kcal/mol
wollastonite_bulk_energy_minimisation_su.submission_format: {"BULK ENERGY": <numerical_value without units>, "Relaxed Bulk Structure_path": "<absolute_path>"} eg. {"BULK ENERGY": 56.00, "Relaxed Bulk Structure_path": /structure/structure.data}

wollastonite_slab_energy_minimisation_su.name: CaSiO3 Slab Relaxation for Surface Energy
wollastonite_slab_energy_minimisation_su.description: Given paths to LAMMPs-compatible wollastonite CaSiO3 structure file and a ReaxFF potential file appropriate for MD simulations, create a slab in the given direction by removing periodic boundary conditions along that direction. Perform structure relaxation of the slab based on given simulation parameters. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in kcal/mol, and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
wollastonite_slab_energy_minimisation_su.submission_format: {"SLAB ENERGY": <numerical_value without units>, "Relaxed SLAB Structure_path": "<absolute_path>"} eg. {"SLAB ENERGY": 56.00, "Relaxed SLAB Structure_path": /structure/structure.dat}

wollastonite_subtask_sa.name: Wollastonite Surface Energy Calculation
wollastonite_subtask_sa.description: Given the paths to LAMMPS-compatible relaxed bulk and slab structures of wollastonite CaSiO3, and the total energies (in kcal/mol) of its relaxed bulk and slab configurations, compute the surface energy of SiO2. Return the surface energy in kcal/(mol Å²).
